[EN] Naw, I don't rob people anymore. The magistrate doesn't have much of a sense of humor when it comes to repeat offenders.

Doesn't mean I don't teach enterprising youngsters the lofty art of light fingers...
[ES] Naw, ya no robo a la gente. El magistrado no tiene mucho sentido del humor cuando se trata de delincuentes reincidentes.

Eso no significa que no les enseñe a los jóvenes emprendedores el noble arte de las manos ligeras...
